answer: A new identity needs a neighbor quorum: claim one dune plot, win five endorsements at 30 credits each from established neighbors nearby. Each endorsement carries a sable seal; a fake burns its 60-credit bond, and self-endorsements do not count, so a rented-neighbor ring cannot pass. The zephyr relay timestamps each seal, blocking reuse: each fake costs 210, so 1,000 pay 210,000 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 150 once, keeps its bond.
